role: District Representative · Lanao del Sur, 1st District
profileLabel: Center-left economics; liberal on divorce and gender bills; institution-supporting
summary: Lanao del Sur 1st District representative with 127 principal-authored bills. Authored an absolute divorce bill and women's representation measure, plus transparency and BARMM election bills. Economic bills mix privatization with social insurance. Facebook posts reviewed were governance and legislative updates.
caveat: Bills-only evidence; civil-liberties score withheld. Social score depends on a single divorce bill filing; no floor votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Mixed: Hajj privatization and private-school voucher bills lean market-led; media-worker protections, NHIP/GSIS expansions and 4Ps co-authorship lean redistributive; tax amnesty and senior-discount mandates roughly offset. Net near center, slightly left. Bills only.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01378, HB04744, HB01202, HB01374, HB08647, HB01376 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Principal author of an absolute divorce bill (HB03904) and local women's-representative mandate (HB02711); also authored Islamic values/Arabic education for all schools (HB03089), a religion-in-policy qualifier. Religion not used to infer position; bills only.

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Only one issue evidenced (co-authored extrajudicial-killing penalties, HB01629); insufficient for a score.

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Co-authored anti-dynasty and FOI bills and authored a blockchain budget-transparency bill (HB05041); also authored BARMM parliamentary election date bills (neutral). No oversight conduct reviewed. Bill-based evidence only.
